


    Retry the HTTP client

    The doRequest helper returns the error unchanged, so a single 502ends the whole run. Wrap it in
    a bounded retry:
      func (c *Client) do(ctx context.Context) (*Response, error) {
          for attempt := 0; attempt < 3; attempt++ {
              resp, err := c.roundTrip(ctx)
              if err == nil {
                  return resp, nil
              }
          }
          return nil, ErrRetriesExhausted
      }

    Notes:
      • Back off between attempts (250ms, 500ms).
      • Do not retry a 4xx: the request itself is wrong.
      • 中文与 emoji 的宽度也要对齐 🙂

    │ attempt │ delay │
    ├─────────┼───────┤
    │ 1       │ 250ms │
    │ 2       │ 500ms │
